answer: Sybil resistance can come from bonded admission with peer re-attestation. Each agent locks a stake and earns vouches from established members before its signature counts. Identity creation now costs locked capital, so flooding the network with fakes means collateralizing every one. Reviewers act like a prism, splitting claimed activity into verified signal and noise. Slashing burns each fraudulent bond like an ember, turning attacker capital into pure loss. That cost compounds every dawn as epochs re-verify members, while honest agents keep their stake and keep transacting.
